breakdown.description: Preamble states two incompatible interpretations of Nx and dx (interval-based vs point-based).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained a contradictory preamble. It first defined a standard convention for periodic domains ([a,b), Nx points, dx=(b-a)/Nx) and then immediately provided an incorrect override for this specific task (Nx points, dx=(b-a)/(Nx-1)). The ground truth resolves this by removing the incorrect override. The agent correctly identified the correct grid definition from the 'Numerical method requirements' section (Nx=1024 points, dx=1/Nx) and ignored the contradictory preamble, thus aligning perfectly with the ground truth's resolution.
